description.value:
Whenever the white mage cast a spell with an area described as a radius, she may decide to make the radius smaller. She may reduce the radius down by any number of 5-foot increments, to a minimum of a 5-foot-radius.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
